ticket.subject: PAYMENT FAILED FOR STARTER RENEWAL
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

The card payment for our Starter renewal was declined, and we got a warning that access will be suspended.

Our bank says it never saw the payment attempt, so we think the problem is on the payment side. We already updated the card details once and the retry failed again. We are not happy that this happened at all.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Can you send a payment link or let us pay by bank transfer instead?

Regards,
Darius
